description: Seven investigated papers with submitted reproduction artifacts. Difficulty is an initial estimate, not a measured ranking. Original artifacts only; injected faults excluded. Execution success is separate from scientific agreement.

resources.policy: One repair agent and one experiment container at a time. Scoped original workloads; report incomplete coverage.

papers.title: Estimating Heterogeneous Treatment Effects and the Effects of Heterogeneous Treatments with Ensemble Methods
papers.reason: Archived R learners, native libraries and Java dependencies; an observed model-frame type failure.
papers.scope: One supplied empirical application; exclude the full simulation grid.

papers.title: Lethal Force in Black and White: Assessing Racial Disparities in the Circumstances of Police Killings
papers.reason: Fragile category merges and positional column repairs precede several statistical learners.
papers.scope: Original cleaning and a declared analysis on the 700-row supplied dataset.

papers.title: How Do Observers Assess Resolve?
papers.reason: Multi-stage R/Stata workflow, supplied-data handoff, factor handling and fixed eight-worker parallelism.
papers.scope: One supplied conjoint-analysis path; one worker, no new survey collection.

papers.title: Generalized Synthetic Control Method: Causal Inference with Interactive Fixed Effects Models
papers.reason: Bundled historical R/C++ package and changed estimation API; expensive bootstrap sections.
papers.scope: One original turnout-data specification; full Monte Carlo grid outside scope.

papers.title: How Robust Standard Errors Expose Methodological Problems They Do Not Fix, and What to Do About It
papers.reason: Hardcoded coefficient layouts and bootstrap covariance dimensions in historical scripts.
papers.scope: Accessible Dreher–Jensen empirical example; restricted files and full bootstrap suite explicitly assessed.

papers.title: Answering Regular Path Queries through Exemplars
papers.reason: Research-specific compilation and graph/query file conventions with several search variants.
papers.scope: One bundled graph/query workload, sequential algorithms; no enlarged benchmark graphs.

papers.title: Adaptive Time Series Anomaly Detection for Online Services via System Failure Sketching
papers.reason: Python 3.6-era scientific dependencies and Numba/STUMPY integration.
papers.scope: Supplied Yahoo demonstration, headless plots, one native thread.
